Politics · India

Uddhav Thackeray calls for change, backs Sonam Wangchuk protest

Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray has called for a fight to change the current government, which he described as unaccountable. He expressed support for activist Sonam Wangchuk's protest, stating the fight extends beyond Wangchuk's cause. Thackeray also criticized the BJP and the NDA government, linking his remarks to the NEET row.
